tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: CGC Airport Transfers business facts: contact, hours, fleet, inclusions and policies. Private pre-booked transfers, not a taxi or rideshare.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Exact fixed prices for a transfer between two locations, straight from the live booking engine. Per vehicle, AUD, GST and tolls included, locked at booking, no surge. If the route has no fixed price the response says so — never estimate a figure yourself. Every quote without stops includes book_url

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Whether CGC can take a pre-booked pickup at a given date and time. Transfers run 24/7 by pre-booking, including Christmas Day. Standard rates apply 6am–8:30pm AEST; pickups between 8:30pm and 6am carry an after-hours fee, shown in the quote before booking. Holiday hours over Christmas and New Year 2

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Lodge a booking. On success this returns a secure checkout_url: give it to the customer to pay directly (their card, never through you). No payment is ever taken through this tool itself. A pickup on a closed day or inside a blackout window is refused (accepted:false) before anything is lodged. Stop

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_quote" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_quote, check_availability · Private data: get_service_info, check_availability, request_booking · Public sink: request_booking · Destructive: check_availability.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_quote, check_availability · Private data: get_service_info, check_availability, request_booking · Public sink: request_booking · Destructive: check_availability

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
